name: Gap-Cadence Event Calendar Run-In
note: Reconstructs a recurring event calendar from the symbol's OWN bars: take the largest |open/prev-close - 1| jumps in a trailing window, keep the longest subset whose consecutive spacings all fall inside an admissible band, and forecast the next event at last + median spacing. Go long from entry_off bars before that forecast and exit exit_off bars before it -- always flat across the event itself. Self-falsifying: a forecast date that passes without a jump of stale_mult times the typical detected-event jump retires the symbol until a new event is observed. Spacings are in BARS, not sessions, because the probe data is far shorter than a quarterly cycle; on daily bars the band should be set to the 55-70 session spacing the source specifies, and the staleness reference is the median jump of the events the fit itself found rather than a 250-session median. Candidates are chosen with non-maximum suppression (min_sep bars apart, defaulting to half the low end of the spacing band) so that one violent event cannot occupy several candidate slots with its own neighbouring bars -- the source picks the 12 largest gap SESSIONS, which are distinct by construction.
source: Beaver (1968) on announcement-period return variance and trading volume, cited in Kothari & Warner (2006) footnote 1. Frazzini & Lamont (2007) 'The Earnings Announcement Premium and Trading Volume' (NBER WP 13090) for the run-in premium. The gap-cadence reconstruction device itself is a synthesis -- no earnings calendar is available on this feed, so the event dates are inferred from the periodicity of the symbol's own overnight gaps, and the estimator is falsifiable.

import heapq


def family_init(ctx):
    b = ctx.bars
    n = len(b)
    o = [float(x["o"]) for x in b]
    c = [float(x["c"]) for x in b]
    gap = [0.0] * n
    for j in range(1, n):
        if c[j - 1] > 0:
            gap[j] = abs(o[j] / c[j - 1] - 1.0)

    W = int(ctx.p.look_n)
    K = int(ctx.p.cand_n)
    lo = int(ctx.p.span_lo)
    hi = int(ctx.p.span_hi)
    need = int(ctx.p.min_dates)
    drift = int(ctx.p.drift_tol)
    step = max(5, int(ctx.p.refit_every))
    eoff = int(ctx.p.entry_off)
    xoff = int(ctx.p.exit_off)
    slack = int(ctx.p.slack)
    smult = float(ctx.p.stale_mult)
    sep = int(ctx.p.min_sep) if int(ctx.p.min_sep) > 0 else max(1, lo // 2)

    inwin = [0] * n
    pred = None
    A = None
    ref = 0.0
    blocked = False
    blocked_A = None
    checked = True

    j = W
    nxt = W
    while j < n:
        if j >= nxt:
            nxt = j + step
            s = j - W
            # one candidate per event, not per bar: the source picks the 12
            # largest gap SESSIONS, so suppress neighbours of a chosen bar
            pool = heapq.nlargest(K * 8, range(s, j + 1), key=lambda q: gap[q])
            picked = []
            for q in pool:
                if gap[q] <= 0.0:
                    continue
                if all(abs(q - z) >= sep for z in picked):
                    picked.append(q)
                    if len(picked) >= K:
                        break
            cand = sorted(picked)
            m_ = len(cand)
            best = None
            if m_ >= need:
                # longest chain of candidate dates whose consecutive spacings
                # all sit inside the admissible band -- the calendar
                dp = [1] * m_
                par = [-1] * m_
                for aa in range(m_):
                    for bb in range(aa):
                        d = cand[aa] - cand[bb]
                        if lo <= d <= hi and dp[bb] + 1 > dp[aa]:
                            dp[aa] = dp[bb] + 1
                            par[aa] = bb
                bi = 0
                for q in range(m_):
                    if dp[q] > dp[bi]:
                        bi = q
                if dp[bi] >= need:
                    chain = []
                    q = bi
                    while q >= 0:
                        chain.append(cand[q])
                        q = par[q]
                    chain.reverse()
                    best = chain
            if best:
                sp = [best[q + 1] - best[q] for q in range(len(best) - 1)]
                if len(sp) >= 2 and abs(sp[-1] - sp[-2]) > drift:
                    pred = None          # the cadence has drifted; do not forecast
                else:
                    ss = sorted(sp)
                    md = ss[len(ss) // 2]
                    newA = best[-1]
                    if blocked and blocked_A is not None and newA > blocked_A:
                        blocked = False
                    if newA != A:
                        checked = False
                    A = newA
                    pred = A + md
                    gs = sorted(gap[q] for q in best)
                    ref = gs[len(gs) // 2]
            else:
                pred = None

        if pred is not None:
            if not checked and j > pred + slack:
                checked = True
                a0 = max(0, pred - slack)
                a1 = min(j - 1, pred + slack)
                mx = 0.0
                for q in range(a0, a1 + 1):
                    if gap[q] > mx:
                        mx = gap[q]
                if mx < smult * ref:
                    # the forecast date came and went without an event:
                    # the cadence is stale, sit out until a new one is observed
                    blocked = True
                    blocked_A = A
            if (not blocked and A is not None and j > A
                    and (pred - eoff) <= j <= (pred - xoff)):
                inwin[j] = 1
        j += 1

    ctx.win = ctx.series(inwin, "run_in_window")


def signal(ctx, i):
    return 1 if ctx.win[i] else 0
